title: Mind the Approximation: Fisher-Weighted SVD Compression for ViTs
abstract: arXiv:2609.07155v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model compression is key to mitigate deployment challenges of ever growing machine learning models. In this area of research, singular value decomposition (SVD)-based compression offers a compelling trade-off between computational efficiency and model accuracy. Fisher-weighted SVD in particular provides principled, loss-aware compression. However, we find that improving the fidelity of Fisher approximation used in the compression is poorly predictive of post-compression accuracy for Vision Transformers (ViTs). Motivated by this observation, we propose FACTS, a structured Fisher Approximation tailored to Compressing ViTs with Fisher-weighted SVD, which enforces token-local aggregation while preserving within-token activation-gradient dependence. translated_title: 注意近似问题：面向视觉Transformer的Fisher加权SVD压缩
translated_abstract: 模型压缩是缓解日益庞大的机器学习模型部署挑战的关键。在该研究领域中，基于奇异值分解（SVD）的压缩在计算效率和模型精度之间提供了出色的权衡。其中，Fisher加权SVD尤其能够提供有原则的、损失感知的压缩。然而，我们发现提高压缩中使用的Fisher近似的保真度，对视觉Transformer（ViT）压缩后的精度预测效果很差。受这一观察的启发，我们提出了FACTS，一种专门为基于Fisher加权SVD压缩ViT而设计的结构化Fisher近似方法，它在保持token内激活-梯度依赖性的同时强制执行token局部聚合。此外，我们引入了一种快速的约束秩搜索，在满足固定浮点运算量（FLOP）约束的前提下优化逐层秩分配。大量实验...
tldr: 本文发现提高Fisher近似保真度并不能有效预测ViT压缩后的精度，据此提出结构化Fisher近似方法FACTS及快速的约束秩搜索CoRS，在固定FLOP约束下实现视觉Transformer的高效Fisher加权SVD压缩。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FACTS, a structured Fisher approximation tailored for Fisher-weighted SVD compression of Vision Transformers, together with a fast Constrained Rank Search (CoRS) that optimizes layer-wise rank allocation under fixed FLOP constraints.
